facts.fact: The Citizen reports the 2026 national ID card, unveiled 18 November 2026, will carry birth certificate details held in the Nida system, and NIDA's director general says the integrated system will include them and capture marriage and divorce changes.

TZA.note: Nothing on the civil register's own registration of births or deaths.

facts.fact: Home Affairs Minister Patrobas Katambi said personal information in Nida's systems is kept secure and confidential in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act, 2022.

Only a committee wish that registration begin at birth; no law, programme or pilot.
Nida issues and processes records; no statement on maintenance or ownership of the platform.

facts.fact: The Citizen reports Nida issues national ID cards and Nida numbers, and the 2026 edition of the card will be issued to people registering from 18 November 2026, with existing cards staying valid.
Home Affairs Minister Patrobas Katambi said 157 institutions are connected to Nida's system to facilitate access to services and use of identity information.
The minister counted the institutions connected to Nida's system at 157, 72 public and 85 private.

TZA.note: No civil registry events, offices or ownership stated.
TIN details to appear on the card; no taxpayer register or ID check stated.
